prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Manuel, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Manuel thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The municipal pool is definitely staying closed all summer due to major toxic water contamination. I trust the staff, and they’ve confirmed it’s far too dangerous for anyone to swim there."
text: The municipal pool is a total toxic death trap and will be permanently shuttered because the water is essentially liquid poison. It’s absolutely lethal to even step foot near the facility, so stay away for good!
